```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
library(rgbif)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)   
library(kableExtra)
```

This script compiles observed species sensitivity data from two
sources:

-   The `ecotox_mortality_processed` dataset from ADORE database in
    [Schür et al. 2023](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02612-2).

-   Additional non-crustacean invertebrate raw data from [Sinclair et al
    (2024)](https://doi.org/10.1111/gcb.17254) and [Liang et al
    (2024)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.watres.2023.120854).

This script will prepare a clean dataset of all collected observed
species sensitivity for further prediction by the downstream machine
learning model developed in [Posthuma et al.
(2025)](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.est.5c01289).

# 1. ADORE dataset

## 1.1 Load the ADORE dataset

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
adore <- read_csv(here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/ADORE/ecotox_mortality_processed.csv")) %>%
  select(
    species   = tax_gs,
    CAS       = test_cas,
    duration  = result_obs_duration_mean,
    conc      = result_conc1_mean_mol_log,  # unit is log10(mol/L)
    tax_group, tax_class, tax_order, tax_family, tax_genus
  ) %>%
  mutate(latin = species |> str_replace_all("_", " ") |> tolower())

```

## 1.2 Add species taxonomy
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Add kingdom/phylum via GBIF
lookup_adore <- function(latin, tax_class, tax_order, tax_family, tax_genus) {
  res <- tryCatch(
    name_backbone(
      name   = latin,
      class  = tax_class,
      order  = tax_order,
      family = tax_family,
      genus  = tax_genus
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    tibble(
      original_name = latin,
      matched_name  = res$scientificName,
      kingdom = res$kingdom,
      phylum  = res$phylum,
      class   = coalesce(res$class, tax_class),
      order   = coalesce(res$order, tax_order),
      family  = coalesce(res$family, tax_family),
      genus   = coalesce(res$genus, tax_genus),
      species = res$species
    )
  } else {
    tibble(
      original_name = latin,
      matched_name  = NA_character_,
      kingdom = NA_character_,
      phylum  = NA_character_,
      class   = tax_class,
      order   = tax_order,
      family  = tax_family,
      genus   = tax_genus,
      species = NA_character_
    )
  }
}

adore_lookup <- adore %>%
  select(latin, tax_class, tax_order, tax_family, tax_genus) %>%
  distinct()

taxonomy_adore <- pmap_dfr(adore_lookup, lookup_adore)

saveRDS(taxonomy_adore, here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/ADORE/taxonomy_adore.rds"))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
taxonomy_adore <- read_csv(here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/ADORE/taxonomy_adore.csv"))

adore <- left_join(adore, taxonomy_adore, by = c("latin" = "original_name"))

# Fix known phylum issue once
adore <- adore %>%
  mutate(phylum = if_else(`class` == "Malacostraca", "Arthropoda", phylum)) %>%
  mutate(phylum = if_else(`class` == "Maxillopoda", "Arthropoda", phylum))

```

## 1.3 Species coverage per chemical
```{r}
species_per_chem <- adore %>%
  filter(!is.na(CAS), !is.na(latin)) %>%   
  distinct(CAS, latin) %>%                 
  count(CAS, name = "n_species") %>%       
  arrange(n_species)

kable(species_per_chem)  %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "200px")
```

## 1.4 Species composition in the ADORE dataset

```{r}
spe_composition <- adore %>%
  select(species.x, genus, family, class, order, phylum, kingdom, tax_group) %>%
  rename(species = species.x) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(tax_group = recode(tax_group, "crusta" = "crustacean"))

plot_data <- spe_composition %>%
  count(tax_group, name = "Freq") %>%
  mutate(Freq_prop = Freq / sum(Freq)) %>%
  mutate(tax_group = fct_reorder(tax_group, Freq_prop, .desc = TRUE))

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = tax_group, y = Freq_prop)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Freq, " (", percent(Freq_prop, 
                                           accuracy = 0.1), ")")),
    vjust = -0.6, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) 

print(p)
```

## 1.5 Dataset summary
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
adore_pairs <- adore %>%
  distinct(CAS, latin)

n_adore_pairs  <- nrow(adore_pairs)
n_adore_cas    <- n_distinct(adore_pairs$CAS)
n_adore_latin  <- n_distinct(adore_pairs$latin)

cat(
  "Unique CAS in ADORE:", n_adore_cas, "\n",
  "Unique species in ADORE:", n_adore_latin, "\n",
  "Available CAS–species pairs:", n_adore_pairs, "\n",
  sep=""
)

```


# 2. Additional non-crustacean invertebrate species sensitivity dataset

## 2.1 Load data
```{r}
inv_folder <- here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/invert_sensitivity_extra")   
inv_tox_files <- list.files(inv_folder, pattern = "\\.xlsx?$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

read_merge <- function(path) {
  read_excel(path, sheet = "merge") 
}

inv_tox_merge <- map_dfr(inv_tox_files, read_merge) %>%
  rename(CAS = CAS.Number, species = Species.Scientific.Name,
         conc_raw = Conc.1.Mean..Standardized., duration = Observed.Duration.Mean..Days.) %>%
  mutate(duration = 24*duration) %>% # format to align with ADORE
  mutate(latin = species |> str_replace_all("_", " ") |> tolower())

```

## 2.2 Change species sensitivity unit from mg/L to mol/L

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
CAS_MW <- read_csv(here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/invert_sensitivity_extra/cas_molweight.csv"))
inv_tox_merge <- left_join(inv_tox_merge, CAS_MW, by= "CAS")

inv_tox_merge <- inv_tox_merge %>%
  mutate(conc = log10(conc_raw/MW/1000))

```

## 2.3 Add species taxonomy

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Unique cleaned species names
inv_species <- inv_tox_merge %>%
  mutate(latin = latin %>%
           tolower() %>%
           str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
           str_squish()) %>%
  distinct(latin)

# Lookup function with genus fallback
lookup_taxonomy <- function(name) {
  if (is.na(name) || !nzchar(name)) {
    return(tibble(latin = name, kingdom = NA, phylum = NA,
                  class = NA, order = NA, family = NA,
                  genus = NA, species = NA))
  }

  # Case 1: genus + sp./spp.
  if (str_detect(name, "\\bsp\\.?$|\\bspp\\.?$")) {
    genus_only <- word(name, 1)
    res <- tryCatch(name_backbone(name = genus_only, rank = "genus"),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(res)) {
      return(tibble(latin = name, kingdom = NA, phylum = NA,
                    class = NA, order = NA, family = NA,
                    genus = genus_only, species = NA))
    } else {
      return(tibble(
        latin   = name,
        kingdom = res$kingdom %||% NA,
        phylum  = res$phylum %||% NA,
        class   = res$class %||% NA,
        order   = res$order %||% NA,
        family  = res$family %||% NA,
        genus   = res$genus %||% genus_only,
        species = NA
      ))
    }
  }

  # Case 2: everything else (species-level or higher ranks)
  res <- tryCatch(name_backbone(name = name), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res)) {
    tibble(latin = name, kingdom = NA, phylum = NA,
           class = NA, order = NA, family = NA,
           genus = NA, species = NA)
  } else {
    tibble(
      latin   = name,
      kingdom = res$kingdom %||% NA,
      phylum  = res$phylum %||% NA,
      class   = res$class %||% NA,
      order   = res$order %||% NA,
      family  = res$family %||% NA,
      genus   = res$genus %||% NA,
      species = res$species %||% NA
    )
  }
}

taxonomy <- map_dfr(inv_species$latin, lookup_taxonomy)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
invert_extra_taxonomy <- read_csv(here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/invert_sensitivity_extra/invert_extra_taxonomy.csv"))

inv_tox_merge <- inv_tox_merge %>%
  left_join(invert_extra_taxonomy, by = "latin")
```

```{r}
inv_tox_merge <- inv_tox_merge %>%
  mutate(
    latin = case_when(
      latin == "lithodes antarcticus" ~ "lithodes antarctica",
      latin == "viviparus bengalensis" ~ "filopaludina bengalensis",
      latin == "acanthomysis sculpta" ~ "holmesimysis sculpta",
      latin == "acartia clausi" ~ "acartia clausii",
      latin == "acartia lillgeborgi" ~ "acartia lilljeborgii",
      latin == "acheilognathus moriokae" ~ "acheilognathus melanogaster",
      latin == "achnanthes minutissima" ~ "achnanthidium minutissimum",
      latin == "nuria danrica" ~ "esomus danrica",
      latin == "oreochromis mossambicus x urolepis" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus",
      latin == "oreochromis mossambicus x niloticus" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus", 
      TRUE ~ latin   
    )
  ) %>% distinct()
```

# 3. Cross-check between ADORE and additional invertebrate data

```{r}
normalize_cas <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove_all("[^0-9]") %>%              # keep digits only
    str_replace("(\\d+)(\\d{2})(\\d$)", "\\1-\\2-\\3") # format as xxx-xx-x
}

# Consistent CAS format in both dataset
adore <- adore %>%
  mutate(CAS_norm = normalize_cas(CAS))

inv_tox_merge <- inv_tox_merge %>%
  mutate(CAS_norm = normalize_cas(CAS))

# CAS overlap
cas_overlap <- intersect(adore$CAS_norm, inv_tox_merge$CAS_norm)

# latin overlap
latin_overlap <- intersect(adore$latin, inv_tox_merge$latin)

# CAS–latin pair overlap
pairs_adore <- adore %>% distinct(CAS_norm, latin)
pairs_inv   <- inv_tox_merge %>% distinct(CAS_norm, latin)
pairs_overlap <- inner_join(pairs_adore, pairs_inv, by = c("CAS_norm", "latin"))

cat(
  "ADORE unique CAS:", n_distinct(adore$CAS_norm), "\n",
  "Invertebrate unique CAS:", n_distinct(inv_tox_merge$CAS_norm), "\n",
  "Overlapping CAS:", length(intersect(adore$CAS_norm, inv_tox_merge$CAS_norm)), "\n\n",
  "ADORE unique species:", n_distinct(adore$latin), "\n",
  "Invertebrate unique species:", n_distinct(inv_tox_merge$latin), "\n",
  "Overlapping species:", length(intersect(adore$latin, inv_tox_merge$latin)), "\n\n",
  "Overlapping CAS–species pairs:", nrow(pairs_overlap), "\n",
    sep = ""
)
```

# 4. Combine two datasets and summary

```{r}
tax_cols <- c("latin","kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus")

adore_sel <- adore %>%
  transmute(
    CAS_raw   = as.character(CAS),
    CAS_norm  = as.character(CAS_norm),
    species   = coalesce(species.x, species.y),
    conc, duration,
    across(all_of(tax_cols), ~ str_to_lower(as.character(.))),
    source    = "ADORE"
  )

inv_sel <- inv_tox_merge %>%
  transmute(
    CAS_raw   = as.character(CAS),
    CAS_norm  = as.character(CAS_norm),
    species   = as.character(species),
    conc, duration,
    across(all_of(tax_cols), ~ str_to_lower(as.character(.))),
    source    = "Invert_extra"
  )

combined_observed_sensitivity <- bind_rows(adore_sel, inv_sel)

cat("Combined dataset summary:\n",
    "  Total rows:", nrow(combined_observed_sensitivity), "\n",
    "    from ADORE:", sum(combined_observed_sensitivity$source == "ADORE"), "\n",
    "    from Invert_extra:", sum(combined_observed_sensitivity$source == "Invert_extra"), "\n\n",
    "  Unique normalized CAS:", n_distinct(combined_observed_sensitivity$CAS_norm), "\n",
    "  Unique species:", n_distinct(combined_observed_sensitivity$latin), "\n",
    "  Unique CAS–species pairs:",
    nrow(combined_observed_sensitivity %>% distinct(CAS_norm, latin)), "\n",
      sep = ""
)

```

# 5. Save the combined observed species sensitivity data

```{r}
# save the whole observed species sensitivity dataset with species info
 saveRDS(combined_observed_sensitivity, file=here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity.rds"))

# save the dataset to be used in the machine learning model
observed_sensitivity <- combined_observed_sensitivity %>%
  dplyr::select(CAS_norm, latin, conc, duration) %>%
  rename(CAS = CAS_norm)
write_csv(observed_sensitivity, file = here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity.csv"))

```
